services.name: boat tour
services.desc: Gansett Cruises offers the best 60-minute and 70-minute narrated harbor boat tours and sunset cruises on the Narragansett Bay! Cruise in comfort as you enjoy a scenic tour of Newport and Jamestown. Sip on Rhode Island’s favorite cocktails, mocktails, beer, wine, and more while you cruise. Complimentary and cash bar options are available on each cruise. Experience Newport as it awakens on a morning harbor tour. The Early Bird harbor cruise winds through historic waterways as our tour guide shares their storied past. services.name: private charter
services.desc: Enjoy magnificent Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay aboard M/V Gansett for that special occasion! Unforgettable on-board parties with family, sunset tours of the harbor with friends, corporate cocktail parties, breakfast meetings-at-sea, a special anniversary- even weddings and small receptions. We always try to make each cruise and each moment unforgettable. We are happy to work with event planners, florists, caterers and more! Sail with the largest fleet of America’s Cup Winners in the world. Come race, train, celebrate or just relax aboard our legendary Classic America’s Cup 12 Meter yachts. blurb: Guests cruise aboard the M/V Gansett, a traditionally restored 50-ft lobster boat, on narrated tours of Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay. Tours include morning, afternoon, and sunset cruises with complimentary drinks and cash bar options. Private charters and special event cruises are also available.
